title: Pattern first optimization second
body_or_script: The system can prepare content, but it should not pretend to learn until real human-entered metrics exist.
caption: Pattern first. Optimization second.
notes: Manual publish only after Day010 checklist is clear.

title: Keep collecting
hook: If no real metrics exist, the honest answer is: keep collecting.
body_or_script: Zero rows are not failure and not success. They are placeholders until a human publishes and records what happened.
caption: No real data, no fake learning.
notes: Manual publish only after Day010 checklist is clear.

title: Calm pattern
hook: A calm pattern beats a dramatic prediction.
body_or_script: The useful next step is usually quieter than the dramatic answer you hoped for: name the pattern, then choose.
caption: Calm pattern, safer action.
notes: Manual publish only after Day010 checklist is clear.

title: This week built the loop
hook: This week built the loop. Publishing and real data are the next human steps.
body_or_script: Weekly recap: competitor learning, seven-day calendar, Day003-Day010 assets, queues, and KPI templates are ready for manual operation.
caption: Prepared by machine. Activated by human.
asset_note: Do not claim live traffic or revenue.

title: Do not optimize from empty rows
hook: Do not optimize from empty rows. Wait for real KPI.
body_or_script: KPI note: analysis remains blocked until non-placeholder metrics exist for published content.
caption: Real KPI first. Optimization second.
asset_note: KPI analysis blocked; no fake performance.
notes: Manual KPI entry required before analysis.
